ayahs.arabicText: الٓرٰ١۫ كِتٰبٌ اُحْكِمَتْ اٰیٰتُهٗ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِنْ لَّدُنْ حَكِیْمٍ خَبِیْرٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Alif, Lam, Ra. [This is] a Book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] Wise and Acquainted.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا اِلَّا اللّٰهَ١ؕ اِنَّنِیْ لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِیْرٌ وَّ بَشِیْرٌۙ
ayahs.translation: [Through a messenger, saying], "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings,"

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوْبُوْۤا اِلَیْهِ یُمَتِّعْكُمْ مَّتَاعًا حَسَنًا اِلٰۤى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَّ یُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِیْ فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهٗ١ؕ وَ اِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَیْكُمْ عَذَابَ یَوْمٍ كَبِیْرٍ
ayahs.translation: And [saying], "Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, [and] He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor. But if you turn away, then indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great Day.

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَى اللّٰهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ١ۚ وَ هُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: To Allah is your return, and He is over all things competent."

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَاۤ اِنَّهُمْ یَثْنُوْنَ صُدُوْرَهُمْ لِیَسْتَخْفُوْا مِنْهُ١ؕ اَلَا حِیْنَ یَسْتَغْشُوْنَ ثِیَابَهُمْ١ۙ یَعْلَمُ مَا یُسِرُّوْنَ وَ مَا یُعْلِنُوْنَ١ۚ اِنَّهٗ عَلِیْمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: Unquestionably, they the disbelievers turn away their breasts to hide themselves from Him. Unquestionably, [even] when they cover themselves in their clothing, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا مِنْ دَآبَّةٍ فِی الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا عَلَى اللّٰهِ رِزْقُهَا وَ یَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَ مُسْتَوْدَعَهَا١ؕ كُلٌّ فِیْ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ فِیْ سِتَّةِ اَیَّامٍ وَّ كَانَ عَرْشُهٗ عَلَى الْمَآءِ لِیَبْلُوَكُمْ اَیُّكُمْ اَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا١ؕ وَ لَئِنْ قُلْتَ اِنَّكُمْ مَّبْعُوْثُوْنَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ الْمَوْتِ لَیَقُوْلَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: And it is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and His Throne had been upon water - that He might test you as to which of you is best in deed. But if you say, "Indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "This is not but obvious magic."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ اَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ اِلٰۤى اُمَّةٍ مَّعْدُوْدَةٍ لَّیَقُوْلُنَّ مَا یَحْبِسُهٗ١ؕ اَلَا یَوْمَ یَاْتِیْهِمْ لَیْسَ مَصْرُوْفًا عَنْهُمْ وَ حَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ یَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And if We hold back from them the punishment for a limited time, they will surely say, "What detains it?" Unquestionably, on the Day it comes to them, it will not be averted from them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ اَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنٰهَا مِنْهُ١ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَیَئُوْسٌ كَفُوْرٌ
ayahs.translation: And if We give man a taste of mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him, indeed, he is despairing and ungrateful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ اَذَقْنٰهُ نَعْمَآءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَیَقُوْلَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّیِّاٰتُ عَنِّیْ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُوْرٌۙ
ayahs.translation: But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful -

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا الَّذِیْنَ صَبَرُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَّ اَجْرٌ كَبِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Except for those who are patient and do righteous deeds; those will have forgiveness and great reward.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۢ بَعْضَ مَا یُوْحٰۤى اِلَیْكَ وَ ضَآئِقٌۢ بِهٖ صَدْرُكَ اَنْ یَّقُوْلُوْا لَوْ لَاۤ اُنْزِلَ عَلَیْهِ كَنْزٌ اَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهٗ مَلَكٌ١ؕ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنْتَ نَذِیْرٌ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَّكِیْلٌؕ
ayahs.translation: Then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you, or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "Why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?" But you are only a warner. And Allah is Disposer of all things.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰىهُ١ؕ قُلْ فَاْتُوْا بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِّثْلِهٖ مُفْتَرَیٰتٍ وَّ ادْعُوْا مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Say, "Then bring ten surahs like it that have been invented and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allah, if you should be truthful."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِلَّمْ یَسْتَجِیْبُوْا لَكُمْ فَاعْلَمُوْۤا اَنَّمَاۤ اُنْزِلَ بِعِلْمِ اللّٰهِ وَ اَنْ لَّاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ۚ فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And if they do not respond to you - then know that the Qur'an was revealed with the knowledge of Allah and that there is no deity except Him. Then, would you [not] be Muslims?

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ كَانَ یُرِیْدُ الْحَیٰوةَ الدُّنْیَا وَ زِیْنَتَهَا نُوَفِّ اِلَیْهِمْ اَعْمَالَهُمْ فِیْهَا وَ هُمْ فِیْهَا لَا یُبْخَسُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Whoever desires the life of this world and its adornments - We fully repay them for their deeds therein, and they therein will not be deprived.

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ لَیْسَ لَهُمْ فِی الْاٰخِرَةِ اِلَّا النَّارُ١ۖ٘ وَ حَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوْا فِیْهَا وَ بٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones for whom there is not in the Hereafter but the Fire. And lost is what they did therein, and worthless is what they used to do.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلٰى بَیِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖ وَ یَتْلُوْهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْهُ وَ مِنْ قَبْلِهٖ كِتٰبُ مُوْسٰۤى اِمَامًا وَّ رَحْمَةً١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ یُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ١ؕ وَ مَنْ یَّكْفُرْ بِهٖ مِنَ الْاَحْزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهٗ١ۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِیْ مِرْیَةٍ مِّنْهُ١ۗ اِنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So is one who [stands] upon a clear evidence from his Lord [like the aforementioned]? And a witness from Him follows it, and before it was the Scripture of Moses to lead and as mercy. Those [believers in the former revelations] believe in the Qur'an. But whoever disbelieves in it from the [various] factions - the Fire is his promised destination. So be not in doubt about it. Indeed, it is the truth from your Lord, but most of the people do not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ یُعْرَضُوْنَ عَلٰى رَبِّهِمْ وَ یَقُوْلُ الْاَشْهَادُ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ الَّذِیْنَ كَذَبُوْا عَلٰى رَبِّهِمْ١ۚ اَلَا لَعْنَةُ اللّٰهِ عَلَى الظّٰلِمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah? Those will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied against their Lord." Unquestionably, the curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers.

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ یَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ وَ یَبْغُوْنَهَا عِوَجًا١ؕ وَ هُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Who averted [people] from the way of Allah and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they, concerning the Hereafter, were disbelievers.

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَمْ یَكُوْنُوْا مُعْجِزِیْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ اَوْلِیَآءَ١ۘ یُضٰعَفُ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ١ؕ مَا كَانُوْا یَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَ السَّمْعَ وَ مَا كَانُوْا یُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those were not causing failure [to Allah] on earth, nor did they have besides Allah any protectors. For them the punishment will be multiplied. They were not able to hear, nor did they see.

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ خَسِرُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ ضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا یَفْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّهُمْ فِی الْاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الْاَخْسَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Assuredly, it is they in the Hereafter who will be the greatest losers.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ اَخْبَتُوْۤا اِلٰى رَبِّهِمْ١ۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ١ۚ هُمْ فِیْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds and humbled themselves to their Lord - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide eternally therein.

ayahs.arabicText: مَثَلُ الْفَرِیْقَیْنِ كَالْاَعْمٰى وَ الْاَصَمِّ وَ الْبَصِیْرِ وَ السَّمِیْعِ١ؕ هَلْ یَسْتَوِیٰنِ مَثَلًا١ؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: The example of the two parties is like the blind and deaf, and the seeing and hearing. Are they equal in comparison? Then, will you not remember?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوْحًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖۤ١٘ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِیْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Indeed, I am to you a clear warner

ayahs.arabicText: اَنْ لَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا اِلَّا اللّٰهَ١ؕ اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَیْكُمْ عَذَابَ یَوْمٍ اَلِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: That you not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a painful day."

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَالَ الْمَلَاُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ قَوْمِهٖ مَا نَرٰىكَ اِلَّا بَشَرًا مِّثْلَنَا وَ مَا نَرٰىكَ اتَّبَعَكَ اِلَّا الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ اَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِیَ الرَّاْیِ١ۚ وَ مَا نَرٰى لَكُمْ عَلَیْنَا مِنْ فَضْلٍۭ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كٰذِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: So the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "We do not see you but as a man like ourselves, and we do not see you followed except by those who are the lowest of us [and] at first suggestion. And we do not see in you over us any merit; rather, we think you are liars."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اَرَءَیْتُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُ عَلٰى بَیِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّیْ وَ اٰتٰىنِیْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِنْدِهٖ فَعُمِّیَتْ عَلَیْكُمْ١ؕ اَنُلْزِمُكُمُوْهَا وَ اَنْتُمْ لَهَا كٰرِهُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord while He has given me mercy from Himself but it has been made unapparent to you, should we force it upon you while you are averse to it?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ لَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ مَالًا١ؕ اِنْ اَجْرِیَ اِلَّا عَلَى اللّٰهِ وَ مَاۤ اَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ مُّلٰقُوْا رَبِّهِمْ وَ لٰكِنِّیْۤ اَرٰىكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And O my people, I ask not of you for it any wealth. My reward is not but from Allah. And I am not one to drive away those who have believed. Indeed, they will meet their Lord, but I see that you are a people behaving ignorantly.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ مَنْ یَّنْصُرُنِیْ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِنْ طَرَدْتُّهُمْ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And O my people, who would protect me from Allah if I drove them away? Then will you not be reminded?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَاۤ اَقُوْلُ لَكُمْ عِنْدِیْ خَزَآئِنُ اللّٰهِ وَ لَاۤ اَعْلَمُ الْغَیْبَ وَ لَاۤ اَقُوْلُ اِنِّیْ مَلَكٌ وَّ لَاۤ اَقُوْلُ لِلَّذِیْنَ تَزْدَرِیْۤ اَعْیُنُكُمْ لَنْ یُّؤْتِیَهُمُ اللّٰهُ خَیْرًا١ؕ اَللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِیْۤ اَنْفُسِهِمْ١ۖۚ اِنِّیْۤ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allah or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel, nor do I say of those upon whom your eyes look down that Allah will never grant them any good. Allah is most knowing of what is within their souls. Indeed, I would then be among the wrongdoers."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰنُوْحُ قَدْ جٰدَلْتَنَا فَاَكْثَرْتَ جِدَا لَنَا فَاْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَاۤ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Noah, you have disputed us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اِنَّمَا یَاْتِیْكُمْ بِهِ اللّٰهُ اِنْ شَآءَ وَ مَاۤ اَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "Allah will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause [Him] failure.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا یَنْفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِیْۤ اِنْ اَرَدْتُّ اَنْ اَنْصَحَ لَكُمْ اِنْ كَانَ اللّٰهُ یُرِیْدُ اَنْ یُّغْوِیَكُمْ١ؕ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ١۫ وَ اِلَیْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: And my advice will not benefit you - although I wished to advise you - If Allah should intend to put you in error. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned."

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰىهُ١ؕ قُلْ اِنِ افْتَرَیْتُهٗ فَعَلَیَّ اِجْرَامِیْ وَ اَنَا بَرِیْٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُجْرِمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say [about Prophet Muhammad], "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but I am innocent of what [crimes] you commit."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اُوْحِیَ اِلٰى نُوْحٍ اَنَّهٗ لَنْ یُّؤْمِنَ مِنْ قَوْمِكَ اِلَّا مَنْ قَدْ اٰمَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوْا یَفْعَلُوْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And it was revealed to Noah that, "No one will believe from your people except those who have already believed, so do not be distressed by what they have been doing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِاَعْیُنِنَا وَ وَحْیِنَا وَ لَا تُخَاطِبْنِیْ فِی الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا١ۚ اِنَّهُمْ مُّغْرَقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration and do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ١۫ وَ كُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَیْهِ مَلَاٌ مِّنْ قَوْمِهٖ سَخِرُوْا مِنْهُ١ؕ قَالَ اِنْ تَسْخَرُوْا مِنَّا فَاِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنْكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: And he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, "If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule.

ayahs.arabicText: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ١ۙ مَنْ یَّاْتِیْهِ عَذَابٌ یُّخْزِیْهِ وَ یَحِلُّ عَلَیْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the Hereafter]."

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا وَ فَارَ التَّنُّوْرُ١ۙ قُلْنَا احْمِلْ فِیْهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَیْنِ اثْنَیْنِ وَ اَهْلَكَ اِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَیْهِ الْقَوْلُ وَ مَنْ اٰمَنَ١ؕ وَ مَاۤ اٰمَنَ مَعَهٗۤ اِلَّا قَلِیْلٌ
ayahs.translation: [So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed, We said, "Load upon the ship of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ ارْكَبُوْا فِیْهَا بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ مَجْرٖؔىهَا وَ مُرْسٰىهَا١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ لَغَفُوْرٌ رَّحِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: And [Noah] said, "Embark therein; in the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هِیَ تَجْرِیْ بِهِمْ فِیْ مَوْجٍ كَالْجِبَالِ١۫ وَ نَادٰى نُوْحُ اِ۟بْنَهٗ وَ كَانَ فِیْ مَعْزِلٍ یّٰبُنَیَّ ارْكَبْ مَّعَنَا وَ لَا تَكُنْ مَّعَ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "O my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ سَاٰوِیْۤ اِلٰى جَبَلٍ یَّعْصِمُنِیْ مِنَ الْمَآءِ١ؕ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الْیَوْمَ مِنْ اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا مَنْ رَّحِمَ١ۚ وَ حَالَ بَیْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: [But] he said, "I will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." [Noah] said, "There is no protector today from the decree of Allah, except for whom He gives mercy." And the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قِیْلَ یٰۤاَرْضُ ابْلَعِیْ مَآءَكِ وَ یٰسَمَآءُ اَقْلِعِیْ وَ غِیْضَ الْمَآءُ وَ قُضِیَ الْاَمْرُ وَ اسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُوْدِیِّ وَ قِیْلَ بُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] Judiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَادٰى نُوْحٌ رَّبَّهٗ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنَّ ابْنِیْ مِنْ اَهْلِیْ وَ اِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ وَ اَنْتَ اَحْكَمُ الْحٰكِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰنُوْحُ اِنَّهٗ لَیْسَ مِنْ اَهْلِكَ١ۚ اِنَّهٗ عَمَلٌ غَیْرُ صَالِحٍ١ۖ٘ۗ فَلَا تَسْئَلْنِ مَا لَیْسَ لَكَ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ١ؕ اِنِّیْۤ اَعِظُكَ اَنْ تَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "O Noah, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is [one whose] work was other than righteous, so ask Me not for that about which you have no knowledge. Indeed, I advise you, lest you be among the ignorant."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْۤ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَنْ اَسْئَلَكَ مَا لَیْسَ لِیْ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ١ؕ وَ اِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِیْ وَ تَرْحَمْنِیْۤ اَكُنْ مِّنَ الْخٰسِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Noah] said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers."

ayahs.arabicText: قِیْلَ یٰنُوْحُ اهْبِطْ بِسَلٰمٍ مِّنَّا وَ بَرَكٰتٍ عَلَیْكَ وَ عَلٰۤى اُمَمٍ مِّمَّنْ مَّعَكَ١ؕ وَ اُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ یَمَسُّهُمْ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: It was said, "O Noah, disembark in security from Us and blessings upon you and upon nations [descending] from those with you. But other nations [of them] We will grant enjoyment; then there will touch them from Us a painful punishment."

ayahs.arabicText: تِلْكَ مِنْ اَنْۢبَآءِ الْغَیْبِ نُوْحِیْهَاۤ اِلَیْكَ١ۚ مَا كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُهَاۤ اَنْتَ وَ لَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ هٰذَا١ۛؕ فَاصْبِرْ١ۛؕ اِنَّ الْعَاقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muhammad]. You knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. So be patient; indeed, the [best] outcome is for the righteous.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِلٰى عَادٍ اَخَاهُمْ هُوْدًا١ؕ قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَیْرُهٗ١ؕ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا مُفْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And to 'Aad [We sent] their brother Hud. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors [of falsehood].

ayahs.arabicText: یٰقَوْمِ لَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ اَجْرًا١ؕ اِنْ اَجْرِیَ اِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِیْ فَطَرَنِیْ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: O my people, I do not ask you for it any reward. My reward is only from the one who created me. Then will you not reason?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوْبُوْۤا اِلَیْهِ یُرْسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَیْكُمْ مِّدْرَارًا وَّ یَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً اِلٰى قُوَّتِكُمْ وَ لَا تَتَوَلَّوْا مُجْرِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in showers and increase you in strength [added] to your strength. And do not turn away, [being] criminals."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰهُوْدُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَیِّنَةٍ وَّ مَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِیْۤ اٰلِهَتِنَا عَنْ قَوْلِكَ وَ مَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Hud, you have not brought us clear evidence, and we are not ones to leave our gods on your say-so. Nor are we believers in you.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ نَّقُوْلُ اِلَّا اعْتَرٰىكَ بَعْضُ اٰلِهَتِنَا بِسُوْٓءٍ١ؕ قَالَ اِنِّیْۤ اُشْهِدُ اللّٰهَ وَ اشْهَدُوْۤا اَنِّیْ بَرِیْٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil." He said, "Indeed, I call Allah to witness, and witness [yourselves] that I am free from whatever you associate with Allah

ayahs.arabicText: مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ فَكِیْدُوْنِیْ جَمِیْعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنْظِرُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: Other than Him. So plot against me all together; then do not give me respite.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللّٰهِ رَبِّیْ وَ رَبِّكُمْ١ؕ مَا مِنْ دَآبَّةٍ اِلَّا هُوَ اٰخِذٌۢ بِنَاصِیَتِهَا١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I have relied upon Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds its forelock. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقَدْ اَبْلَغْتُكُمْ مَّاۤ اُرْسِلْتُ بِهٖۤ اِلَیْكُمْ١ؕ وَ یَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّیْ قَوْمًا غَیْرَكُمْ١ۚ وَ لَا تَضُرُّوْنَهٗ شَیْئًا١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ حَفِیْظٌ
ayahs.translation: But if they turn away, [say], "I have already conveyed that with which I was sent to you. My Lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm Him at all. Indeed my Lord is, over all things, Guardian."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا نَجَّیْنَا هُوْدًا وَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهٗ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا١ۚ وَ نَجَّیْنٰهُمْ مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِیْظٍ
ayahs.translation: And when Our command came, We saved Hud and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us; and We saved them from a harsh punishment.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تِلْكَ عَادٌ١ۙ۫ جَحَدُوْا بِاٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَ عَصَوْا رُسُلَهٗ وَ اتَّبَعُوْۤا اَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: And that was 'Aad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اُتْبِعُوْا فِیْ هٰذِهِ الدُّنْیَا لَعْنَةً وَّ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ١ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوْا رَبَّهُمْ١ؕ اَلَا بُعْدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُوْدٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And they were [therefore] followed in this world with a curse and [as well] on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, 'Aad denied their Lord; then away with 'Aad, the people of Hud.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِلٰى ثَمُوْدَ اَخَاهُمْ صٰلِحًا١ۘ قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَیْرُهٗ١ؕ هُوَ اَنْشَاَكُمْ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ وَ اسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِیْهَا فَاسْتَغْفِرُوْهُ ثُمَّ تُوْبُوْۤا اِلَیْهِ١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ قَرِیْبٌ مُّجِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: And to Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰصٰلِحُ قَدْ كُنْتَ فِیْنَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هٰذَاۤ اَتَنْهٰىنَاۤ اَنْ نَّعْبُدَ مَا یَعْبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَا وَ اِنَّنَا لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُوْنَاۤ اِلَیْهِ مُرِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Salih, you were among us a man of promise before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? And indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اَرَءَیْتُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُ عَلٰى بَیِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّیْ وَ اٰتٰىنِیْ مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَنْ یَّنْصُرُنِیْ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِنْ عَصَیْتُهٗ١۫ فَمَا تَزِیْدُوْنَنِیْ غَیْرَ تَخْسِیْرٍ
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has given me mercy from Himself, who would protect me from Allah if I disobeyed Him? So you would not increase me except in loss.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةُ اللّٰهِ لَكُمْ اٰیَةً فَذَرُوْهَا تَاْكُلْ فِیْۤ اَرْضِ اللّٰهِ وَ لَا تَمَسُّوْهَا بِسُوْٓءٍ فَیَاْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allah - [she is] to you a sign. So let her feed upon Allah 's earth and do not touch her with harm, or you will be taken by an impending punishment."

ayahs.arabicText: فَعَقَرُوْهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوْا فِیْ دَارِكُمْ ثَلٰثَةَ اَیَّامٍ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَیْرُ مَكْذُوْبٍ
ayahs.translation: But they hamstrung her, so he said, "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. That is a promise not to be denied."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا نَجَّیْنَا صٰلِحًا وَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهٗ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَ مِنْ خِزْیِ یَوْمِئِذٍ١ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِیُّ الْعَزِیْزُ
ayahs.translation: So when Our command came, We saved Salih and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and [saved them] from the disgrace of that day. Indeed, it is your Lord who is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَخَذَ الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّیْحَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوْا فِیْ دِیَارِهِمْ جٰثِمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone

ayahs.arabicText: كَاَنْ لَّمْ یَغْنَوْا فِیْهَا١ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّ ثَمُوْدَاۡ كَفَرُوْا رَبَّهُمْ١ؕ اَلَا بُعْدًا لِّثَمُوْدَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: As if they had never prospered therein. Unquestionably, Thamud denied their Lord; then, away with Thamud.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَاۤ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ بِالْبُشْرٰى قَالُوْا سَلٰمًا١ؕ قَالَ سَلٰمٌ فَمَا لَبِثَ اَنْ جَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِیْذٍ
ayahs.translation: And certainly did Our messengers come to Abraham with good tidings; they said, "Peace." He said, "Peace," and did not delay in bringing [them] a roasted calf.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا رَاٰۤ اَیْدِیَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ اِلَیْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَ اَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِیْفَةً١ؕ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ اِنَّاۤ اُرْسِلْنَاۤ اِلٰى قَوْمِ لُوْطٍؕ
ayahs.translation: But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not. We have been sent to the people of Lot."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ امْرَاَتُهٗ قَآئِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنٰهَا بِاِسْحٰقَ١ۙ وَ مِنْ وَّرَآءِ اِسْحٰقَ یَعْقُوْبَ
ayahs.translation: And his Wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَتْ یٰوَیْلَتٰۤى ءَاَلِدُ وَ اَنَا عَجُوْزٌ وَّ هٰذَا بَعْلِیْ شَیْخًا١ؕ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَیْءٌ عَجِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: She said, "Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing!"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اَتَعْجَبِیْنَ مِنْ اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ رَحْمَتُ اللّٰهِ وَ بَرَكٰتُهٗ عَلَیْكُمْ اَهْلَ الْبَیْتِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ حَمِیْدٌ مَّجِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ الرَّوْعُ وَ جَآءَتْهُ الْبُشْرٰى یُجَادِلُنَا فِیْ قَوْمِ لُوْطٍؕ
ayahs.translation: And when the fright had left Abraham and the good tidings had reached him, he began to argue with Us concerning the people of Lot.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ لَحَلِیْمٌ اَوَّاهٌ مُّنِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to Allah].

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاِبْرٰهِیْمُ اَعْرِضْ عَنْ هٰذَا١ۚ اِنَّهٗ قَدْ جَآءَ اَمْرُ رَبِّكَ١ۚ وَ اِنَّهُمْ اٰتِیْهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَیْرُ مَرْدُوْدٍ
ayahs.translation: [The angels said], "O Abraham, give up this [plea]. Indeed, the command of your Lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوْطًا سِیْٓءَ بِهِمْ وَ ضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَّ قَالَ هٰذَا یَوْمٌ عَصِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: And when Our messengers, [the angels], came to Lot, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort and said, "This is a trying day."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَآءَهٗ قَوْمُهٗ یُهْرَعُوْنَ اِلَیْهِ١ؕ وَ مِنْ قَبْلُ كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ السَّیِّاٰتِ١ؕ قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِیْ هُنَّ اَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ لَا تُخْزُوْنِ فِیْ ضَیْفِیْ١ؕ اَلَیْسَ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَّشِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: And his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds. He said, "O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِیْ بَنٰتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ١ۚ وَ اِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِیْدُ
ayahs.translation: They said, "You have already known that we have not concerning your daughters any claim, and indeed, you know what we want."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَوْ اَنَّ لِیْ بِكُمْ قُوَّةً اَوْ اٰوِیْۤ اِلٰى رُكْنٍ شَدِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰلُوْطُ اِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنْ یَّصِلُوْۤا اِلَیْكَ فَاَسْرِ بِاَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ الَّیْلِ وَ لَا یَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ اَحَدٌ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَكَ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ مُصِیْبُهَا مَاۤ اَصَابَهُمْ١ؕ اِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ١ؕ اَلَیْسَ الصُّبْحُ بِقَرِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: The angels said, "O Lot, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; [therefore], they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night and let not any among you look back - except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. Indeed, their appointment is [for] the morning. Is not the morning near?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِیَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَ اَمْطَرْنَا عَلَیْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّنْ سِجِّیْلٍ١ۙ۬ مَّنْضُوْدٍۙ
ayahs.translation: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]

ayahs.arabicText: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ١ؕ وَ مَا هِیَ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ بِبَعِیْدٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Marked from your Lord. And Allah 's punishment is not from the wrongdoers [very] far.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِلٰى مَدْیَنَ اَخَاهُمْ شُعَیْبًا١ؕ قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَیْرُهٗ١ؕ وَ لَا تَنْقُصُوا الْمِكْیَالَ وَ الْمِیْزَانَ اِنِّیْۤ اَرٰىكُمْ بِخَیْرٍ وَّ اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَیْكُمْ عَذَابَ یَوْمٍ مُّحِیْطٍ
ayahs.translation: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. And do not decrease from the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, but indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing Day.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ اَوْفُوا الْمِكْیَالَ وَ الْمِیْزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَ لَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشْیَآءَهُمْ وَ لَا تَعْثَوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.

ayahs.arabicText: بَقِیَّتُ اللّٰهِ خَیْرٌ لَّكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِیْنَ١ۚ۬ وَ مَاۤ اَنَا عَلَیْكُمْ بِحَفِیْظٍ
ayahs.translation: What remains [lawful] from Allah is best for you, if you would be believers. But I am not a guardian over you."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰشُعَیْبُ اَصَلٰوتُكَ تَاْمُرُكَ اَنْ نَّتْرُكَ مَا یَعْبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَاۤ اَوْ اَنْ نَّفْعَلَ فِیْۤ اَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشٰٓؤُا١ؕ اِنَّكَ لَاَنْتَ الْحَلِیْمُ الرَّشِیْدُ
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Shu'ayb, does your prayer command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اَرَءَیْتُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُ عَلٰى بَیِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّیْ وَ رَزَقَنِیْ مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا١ؕ وَ مَاۤ اُرِیْدُ اَنْ اُخَالِفَكُمْ اِلٰى مَاۤ اَنْهٰىكُمْ عَنْهُ١ؕ اِنْ اُرِیْدُ اِلَّا الْاِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ١ؕ وَ مَا تَوْفِیْقِیْۤ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ١ؕ عَلَیْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَ اِلَیْهِ اُنِیْبُ
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...? And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allah. Upon him I have relied, and to Him I return.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ لَا یَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِیْۤ اَنْ یُّصِیْبَكُمْ مِّثْلُ مَاۤ اَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوْحٍ اَوْ قَوْمَ هُوْدٍ اَوْ قَوْمَ صٰلِحٍ١ؕ وَ مَا قَوْمُ لُوْطٍ مِّنْكُمْ بِبَعِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: And O my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hud or the people of Salih. And the people of Lot are not from you far away.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوْبُوْۤا اِلَیْهِ١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ رَحِیْمٌ وَّدُوْدٌ
ayahs.translation: And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰشُعَیْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِیْرًا مِّمَّا تَقُوْلُ وَ اِنَّا لَنَرٰىكَ فِیْنَا ضَعِیْفًا١ۚ وَ لَوْ لَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنٰكَ١٘ وَ مَاۤ اَنْتَ عَلَیْنَا بِعَزِیْزٍ
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Shu'ayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. And if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اَرَهْطِیْۤ اَعَزُّ عَلَیْكُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ وَ اتَّخَذْتُمُوْهُ وَرَآءَكُمْ ظِهْرِیًّا١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ مُحِیْطٌ
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people, is my family more respected for power by you than Allah? But you put Him behind your backs [in neglect]. Indeed, my Lord is encompassing of what you do.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْا عَلٰى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّیْ عَامِلٌ١ؕ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ١ۙ مَنْ یَّاْتِیْهِ عَذَابٌ یُّخْزِیْهِ وَ مَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ١ؕ وَ ارْتَقِبُوْۤا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ رَقِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: And O my people, work according to your position; indeed, I am working. You are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. So watch; indeed, I am with you a watcher, [awaiting the outcome]."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا نَجَّیْنَا شُعَیْبًا وَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهٗ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَ اَخَذَتِ الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّیْحَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوْا فِیْ دِیَارِهِمْ جٰثِمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And when Our command came, We saved Shu'ayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone

ayahs.arabicText: كَاَنْ لَّمْ یَغْنَوْا فِیْهَا١ؕ اَلَا بُعْدًا لِّمَدْیَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُوْدُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamud was taken away.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰى بِاٰیٰتِنَا وَ سُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority

ayahs.arabicText: اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَ مَلَاۡئِهٖ فَاتَّبَعُوْۤا اَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ١ۚ وَ مَاۤ اَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not [at all] discerning.

ayahs.arabicText: یَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهٗ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ فَاَوْرَدَهُمُ النَّارَ١ؕ وَ بِئْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُوْدُ
ayahs.translation: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection and lead them into the Fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اُتْبِعُوْا فِیْ هٰذِهٖ لَعْنَةً وَّ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ١ؕ بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُوْدُ
ayahs.translation: And they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the Day of Resurrection. And wretched is the gift which is given.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اَنْۢبَآءِ الْقُرٰى نَقُصُّهٗ عَلَیْكَ مِنْهَا قَآئِمٌ وَّ حَصِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down].

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا ظَلَمْنٰهُمْ وَ لٰكِنْ ظَلَمُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ فَمَاۤ اَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ اٰلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِیْ یَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ شَیْءٍ لَّمَّا جَآءَ اَمْرُ رَبِّكَ١ؕ وَ مَا زَادُوْهُمْ غَیْرَ تَتْبِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: And We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. And they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than Allah when there came the command of your Lord. And they did not increase them in other than ruin.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ اَخْذُ رَبِّكَ اِذَاۤ اَخَذَ الْقُرٰى وَ هِیَ ظَالِمَةٌ١ؕ اِنَّ اَخْذَهٗۤ اَلِیْمٌ شَدِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً لِّمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ الْاٰخِرَةِ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ یَوْمٌ مَّجْمُوْعٌ١ۙ لَّهُ النَّاسُ وَ ذٰلِكَ یَوْمٌ مَّشْهُوْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which the people will be collected, and that is a Day [which will be] witnessed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا نُؤَخِّرُهٗۤ اِلَّا لِاَجَلٍ مَّعْدُوْدٍؕ
ayahs.translation: And We do not delay it except for a limited term.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ یَاْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهٖ١ۚ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِیٌّ وَّ سَعِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: The Day it comes no soul will speak except by His permission. And among them will be the wretched and the prosperous.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ شَقُوْا فَفِی النَّارِ لَهُمْ فِیْهَا زَفِیْرٌ وَّ شَهِیْقٌۙ
ayahs.translation: As for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the Fire. For them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling.

ayahs.arabicText: خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ١ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا یُرِیْدُ
ayahs.translation: [They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ سُعِدُوْا فَفِی الْجَنَّةِ خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ١ؕ عَطَآءً غَیْرَ مَجْذُوْذٍ
ayahs.translation: And as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا تَكُ فِیْ مِرْیَةٍ مِّمَّا یَعْبُدُ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ١ؕ مَا یَعْبُدُوْنَ اِلَّا كَمَا یَعْبُدُ اٰبَآؤُهُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلُ١ؕ وَ اِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوْهُمْ نَصِیْبَهُمْ غَیْرَ مَنْقُوْصٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: So do not be in doubt, [O Muhammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. They worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. And indeed, We will give them their share undiminished.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِیْهِ١ؕ وَ لَوْ لَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِیَ بَیْنَهُمْ١ؕ وَ اِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَیُوَفِّیَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ اَعْمَالَهُمْ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا یَعْمَلُوْنَ خَبِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, each [of the believers and disbelievers] - your Lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. Indeed, He is Acquainted with what they do.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَاۤ اُمِرْتَ وَ مَنْ تَابَ مَعَكَ وَ لَا تَطْغَوْا١ؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allah], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تَرْكَنُوْۤا اِلَى الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ١ۙ وَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ اَوْلِیَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the Fire, and you would not have other than Allah any protectors; then you would not be helped.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ طَرَفَیِ النَّهَارِ وَ زُلَفًا مِّنَ الَّیْلِ١ؕ اِنَّ الْحَسَنٰتِ یُذْهِبْنَ السَّیِّاٰتِ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ ذِكْرٰى لِلذّٰكِرِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اصْبِرْ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا یُضِیْعُ اَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَوْ لَا كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُوْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ اُولُوْا بَقِیَّةٍ یَّنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِی الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا قَلِیْلًا مِّمَّنْ اَنْجَیْنَا مِنْهُمْ١ۚ وَ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مَاۤ اُتْرِفُوْا فِیْهِ وَ كَانُوْا مُجْرِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: So why were there not among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those We saved from among them? But those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِیُهْلِكَ الْقُرٰى بِظُلْمٍ وَّ اَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّ لَا یَزَالُوْنَ مُخْتَلِفِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ.

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا مَنْ رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ١ؕ وَ لِذٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ١ؕ وَ تَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَاَمْلَئَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ اَجْمَعِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَیْكَ مِنْ اَنْۢبَآءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهٖ فُؤَادَكَ١ۚ وَ جَآءَكَ فِیْ هٰذِهِ الْحَقُّ وَ مَوْعِظَةٌ وَّ ذِكْرٰى لِلْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And each [story] We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart. And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قُلْ لِّلَّذِیْنَ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ اعْمَلُوْا عَلٰى مَكَانَتِكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّا عٰمِلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ انْتَظِرُوْا١ۚ اِنَّا مُنْتَظِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And wait, indeed, we are waiting."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لِلّٰهِ غَیْبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ اِلَیْهِ یُرْجَعُ الْاَمْرُ كُلُّهٗ فَاعْبُدْهُ وَ تَوَكَّلْ عَلَیْهِ١ؕ وَ مَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And to Allah belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him. And your Lord is not unaware of that which you do.
